description: Connect your OqoDesk account to ChatGPT or Codex to manage work in your company. Find teammates and locations, review tasks and shifts, create or update tasks, prepare and publish shifts, search documents and chats, and send messages when you ask. Access follows your OqoDesk role and location permissions. Read available PDF or text documents and get help with OqoDesk. An existing company account is required. Hosted file uploads, OCR, training records and absence records are not supported in this version.

defaultPrompt: Show my open tasks and highlight urgent work.
Show my shifts for the next seven days.
Find documents available in my workspace.
